title: Normalized coefficient-ring localization before module transport
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, X noetherian and finite dimensional with l invertible, and R a normalized RationalModuleRealization [lem-per-rational-module-realization-functor]. Put B equal to the completed integral coefficient sheaf, a equal to its canonical constant-section map, t equal to the fixed uniformizer, and S=B[1/a(t)] the sheafified section localization [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization]. There is an isomorphism c:S ≅ E_X of ring sheaves whose composite with B → S is R.integralIso.hom followed by R.inclusion. For every r in A[1/t] and test object U, the inverse c sends the constant rational section pbcRationalCoefficientEquiv(r) to the canonical localized scalar section scalarLocalizationCoefficientMapOfUniverses(r) on U [lem-per-rational-continuous-coefficient-derived-localization]. This statement concerns ring sheaves and their constant sections.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1)-(2), pp. 58-59; coefficient change implicit in Proposition 6.8.14(2), p. 62.

proof.text: Compute the projections of the canonical completed scalar map from its limit normalization. For an integral coefficient z, apply R.integral_normalization to R.integralIso(z), cancel the integral isomorphism with its inverse, and use R.finite_normalization. The resulting residues equal the residues of z. The injective valuation-ring-to-positive-residue-limit equivalence proves that R.integralIso sends each completed scalar to the continuous constant function z. This argument is pointwise and also applies to empty test objects.

Evaluate R.integralIso on each test object. Its ring equivalence takes the powers of the completed uniformizer section onto the powers of the continuous constant uniformizer section. Mathlib IsLocalization.ringEquivOfRingEquiv gives sectionwise localization isomorphisms. Prove naturality by IsLocalization.ringHom_ext, reducing it to naturality of R.integralIso on integral numerators. Apply presheafToSheaf.mapIso and compose with R.localizationIso. Naturality of toSheafify and the two pointwise normalizations R.localization_normalization and R.inclusion_normalization prove the specified unit equation.

The constant-presheaf sheafification adjunction identifies rationalModuleConstantMap on constant generators with continuous constant functions. The canonical pbcRationalCoefficientEquiv agrees on integral generators with the valuation-ring inclusion, by ringEquivOfRingEquiv_eq and the coefficient-field localization algebra equivalence. Compare the two sectionwise ring maps from A[1/t] by IsLocalization.ringHom_ext: on an integral generator the localized coefficient map is the localization unit, and the preceding unit equation, integral scalar comparison and R.inclusion_normalization give equality. Apply c.inv and the component of c.hom_inv_id to obtain the required inverse formula for every fraction.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1)-(2), pp. 58-59; coefficient change implicit in Proposition 6.8.14(2), p. 62. Explicit Lean proof by normalized residues, sectionwise localization and sheafification; no new intermediate obligations.

from.place: Coefficient-ring comparison in the first step of ordinary rational realization localization.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalRealizationCoefficientLocalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ n)]
    [Fact (∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))]
    (R : RationalModuleRealization l E X) :
    let B := pbcAdicCompletion X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)
    let a := pbcCompletedScalarSections X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)
    let t := pbcUniformizer l E
    let S := ringedLocalizationRingOfUniverses.{u + 1, u + 1, u} B (a t)
    ∃ c : S ≅ rationalCoefficientSheaf l X E,
      ringedLocalizationRingUnitOfUniverses.{u + 1, u + 1, u} B (a t) ≫ c.hom =
        R.integralIso.hom ≫ R.inclusion ∧
      ∀ (r : Localization.Away t) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ),
        c.inv.hom.app U
          ((rationalModuleConstantMap l E X).hom.app U
            ((toSheafify (ProEt.topology X)
              ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} E)))).app U
                (ULift.up (pbcRationalCoefficientEquiv l E r)))) =
          (scalarLocalizationCoefficientMapOfUniverses (PbcIntegralRing l E)
            B a t r).val U
